claimBoundary: Validation-reachable EXPRESS conformance is not claimed until every behavior described by the authorized Edition 2 files is implemented and proved. Source-excluded behavior is not claimed.
sourcePolicy: Record non-verbatim derived semantics only. Implement behavior described by the authorized Edition 2 files; record behavior absent from those files as source-excluded and omit it without inference.

families.boundary: Types, declarations, expressions, type compatibility and function calls outside the bounded excerpts are not claimed.
families.exclusion: The authorized Edition 2 files do not contain the normative bodies for clauses 5 through 12.

families.boundary: A null statement performs no action.
Direct, entity-group, explicit-attribute and single-element ARRAY/LIST aliases are statically lowered with lexical scope. Range-alias behavior is absent from the authorized file and source-excluded.

Local/parameter entity references, non-entity value copying, the explicit compatibility alternatives, target defined-type WHERE rules, initialized exact-integer element/range writes, terminal group replacement, and recursive SELECT qualification through ARRAY/BINARY/LIST/STRING or entity attributes/groups are generated statically. Defined scalar qualifier carriers remain invalid under the clause's declared-carrier restriction.
No claim is made for assignment-time constraint categories whose declarations and evaluation rules occur only in missing clauses 5 through 12.
families.exclusion: The excerpt requires target values to satisfy declared constraints but the authorized files do not contain the normative definitions of the complete constraint taxonomy. Reachable defined-type WHERE rules already represented by the compiler are enforced; missing categories are not inferred.

families.boundary: No parser-level conformance claim is made beyond the statically and atomically narrowed generalizations already covered by the implemented assignment paths.
families.exclusion: The excerpt conditions this behavior on a level 4 compliant parser, while the authorized files do not define parser levels or establish that this Analyzer claims level 4.

families.boundary: No additional runtime rejection is generated for partial complex entity combinations beyond the valid closed generated projections.
families.exclusion: The excerpt delegates the definition of a valid complex entity instance to Annex B, which is absent from the authorized files; the missing validity relation is not reconstructed or guessed.

families.boundary: First TRUE compatible label, UNKNOWN/non-value non-selection, OTHERWISE and no-match fall-through are generated. Compatibility detail absent from the authorized files is source-excluded.
A compound is one sequential statement and creates no scope.
ESCAPE exits its enclosing REPEAT; use outside REPEAT is rejected.
Only TRUE executes THEN; FALSE, UNKNOWN and indeterminate execute ELSE or fall through.

Arity, order, sourced assignment compatibility, target defined-type WHERE rules, scalar promotions, defined simple types, SELECT targets, aggregate initializers and entity specialization are checked and adapted at the shared call boundary.
No claim is made for qualified actual-parameter copy-back beyond the direct VAR path already generated.
families.exclusion: Clause 13.8 in the authorized excerpt defines a call parameter as an expression and only states assignment compatibility; the formal VAR declaration and copy-back rules occur in missing clauses and are not inferred.

families.boundary: Numeric controls are captured once; direction, zero, indeterminate controls, immutable NUMBER variable and lexical scope are enforced.
WHILE is evaluated before each iteration and only TRUE enters the body.
UNTIL is evaluated after each body execution; TRUE stops and FALSE or UNKNOWN continues. Indeterminate behavior is absent from the authorized file and source-excluded.
RETURN and SKIP behavior is not claimed by this Edition 2 profile.
families.exclusion: The authorized Edition 2 file ends before page 131 and contains no normative body for these clauses.

families.boundary: Built-in constants, functions, procedures and remaining validation-reachable semantics are not claimed.
families.exclusion: The authorized Edition 2 files do not contain these normative bodies.
